info.title: AEGIS Portfolio Engine API
info.description: Financial read model for the AEGIS ecosystem. CANONICAL contract — committed to GitHub, consumed by aegis-gateway's build-time validator and typed-client generator. NOTES: (1) this engine has NO '/portfolio' prefix — routes sit directly under /api/v1/... (e.g. /api/v1/summary); aegis-gateway previously assumed a '/portfolio' prefix that doesn't exist here, which was the portfolio routing bug. (2) user-facing routes trust an unsigned 'X-User-Id' header rather than independently re-validating the caller's Supabase JWT like the Identity/Wallet-Vault engines do — this diverges from the zero-trust model in aegis-architecture/contracts/api-contracts.md and should be hardened (verify a signed Gateway-issued identity assertion instead of a bare header) as a follow-up. (3) POST /transfer-preview currently has no auth check at all in code (its sibling /payment-preview does) — flagged as a likely oversight, not fixed here since it's engine business logic.

post.description: No auth check in current code (likely oversight — see info.description).

userIdHeader.name: X-User-Id
userIdHeader.description: Gateway-asserted caller identity. Gateway must independently validate the caller's session (requireAuth) and set this header itself when forwarding — this engine trusts the header verbatim and does not re-validate a JWT. See info.description for the hardening note.

portfolioAdminApiKey.name: X-Portfolio-API-Key
portfolioAdminApiKey.description: Engine-to-engine/admin only. The Gateway does not hold this key and must not expose these routes publicly.
